title: Babypop
tagline: A crypto baby registry for family, friends, and degens to connect with parent's they love.
description: This project is for new parents to be allowed to have there friends and family who love the crypto world to purchase helpful items for them on their journey. The parents can create a baby registry using there wallet, then go pick items from the store. The friends or family can purchase  the item which sends funds to the parents wallet. The site also allows for a social side of things so that the parents can share the journey with all who would like to view.
how_its_made: This project uses tableland for the database which stored the users and the products. Lens is used for the social side of things allowing for the user to take there data with them once they have moved on from the site.  Livepeer js sdk for video upload and added to users lens profile. Wagmi was for all things user wallet based wonderful product in my opinion. Ipfs was used with many different sites infura and pinata to store images, those were the easiest to get up and running with. The frontend is built out using next js and tailwind css.
